title: Yoniso
text: 2. -yathayidam bhikkhave yonisomanasikārasampadā || || 3. Yonisomanasikārasampannassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ- || pe () || a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || [page 038] 38 Magga-Saṃyuttam XLV. 4. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti rāgadosa- mohavinayapariyosānam || la || sammāsamādhim bhāveti rāga- dosa- mohavinayapariyosānaṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu yonisomanasikārasampanno a- a- maggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkarotī ti || || Ekadhammapeyyālo || || Uddānaṃ || || Kalyāṇamittaṃ Sīlañca || || Chando ca Attasampadā || || Diṭṭhi ca Appamādo ca || Yoniso bhavati sattamaṃ || || GAṄGĀPEYYĀLO. 1. Sāvatthinidānaṃ || || VIVEKANISSITAM.
